max_drawdown_convention.note: Drawdown LEVELS are NEGATIVE: minimum of (cumulative daily return - running peak); return units for the published books, dollars at minimum size for the dollar book (D542).

universe.leg_rule: n_leg = ceil(n/3); long the LOWEST hedgers' HP; ties by symbol

signal.definition: mean over the last 13 reports (release <= month-end) of commercial long / (long + short); de-meaned = minus the 52-report mean

root_months.unit: book-return units: sign x simple return / positioned count, summed over the month

component_line.rho_with_ledger_entry: ABSENT: the MACD arm's per-session P&L series is not on disk

P-2.claim: daily rho with the term-structure sort on 16 > 0.4

P-3.claim: PL GC PA SI in the long leg >= 70% of month-ends; NG ZW in the short leg >= 70%

P-4.claim: de-meaned cell below the primary; de-meaned above its N3 p95 only if the primary is

P-5.claim: long leg root-month mean > short leg's

P-7.claim: dollar book fails C-d; sub-book sigma <= $500
